{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and cast to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
data_completed = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_revenue = data_completed[data_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Count how many QA orders there are
n_qa = len(qa_revenue)

# Remove QA orders
real_orders = data_completed[data_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute the mean revenue of real completed orders
mean_revenue_real = real_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the number of QA orders
print(n_qa)

# Print the mean revenue
print(mean_revenue_real)

# Print the value of the mean revenue again to ensure it's captured in evidence
mean_revenue_real"}
